Project Manager (also known as Delivery Consultant, or Technical Project Manager or Delivery Manager, or Technical Lead) 
The Role
We are seeking a knowledgeable and passionate Project Manager / Delivery Consultant with 5+ years of experience in Digital Project Management, Business Analysis and Consultancy to help ensure projects are delivered according to the planned timeline, budgets & scope.
Day-to-day, the role requires ownership of the project delivery processes, planning, acceptance, resource management and reporting for the assigned project portfolio; ownership of the end-to-end delivery of the within the agreed project scope, time, cost & quality; and management of project artefacts & documentation.
The role will also require facilitation of the workshops and participation in elicitation, analysis and management of the project requirements and functional design and also monitoring and tracking of the allocated set of tasks and ensuring their timely completion by the team members in alignment with the agreed estimations.
Requirements
•	Previous experience working with either digital agencies, software development companies or tech consultancy firms
•	5+ years of experience in Digital Project Management, Business Analysis and Consultancy
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Experience in and knowledge in relevant Project Management tools & processes.
•	Ability to work in cross functional and geographically distributed teams.

Salary: over threshold

result.description:
Ashburton Aboriginal Corporation (AAC) is seeking a dedicated and community-focused Employment Consultant to support job seekers on their journey toward meaningful and sustainable employment.
In this role, you will provide comprehensive case management to individuals registered with Centrelink, working with people from a wide variety of cultural, social, and economic backgrounds. This includes supporting clients who may be socio-economically disadvantaged, long-term unemployed, or living with disability.
You will build strong, trusting relationships with participants, assess their needs, develop tailored employment plans, and guide them through barriers that may impact their job readiness. The role requires ongoing monitoring, documentation, coaching, and advocacy to ensure each client receives an individualized and culturally appropriate level of support.
Success in this position relies on excellent communication skills, genuine empathy, and strong administrative capabilities to maintain accurate records, manage appointments, and meet program requirements. As an Employment Consultant, you will play a vital role in empowering individuals to build confidence, develop skills, and achieve long-term employment outcomes.
